assets.label: 位面观测阵列
assets.assetType: World-122 connected 4x4 modern planar observation and reconnaissance research facility
assets.paletteConstraint: low-saturation cool pale mineral panels and weathered precast concrete, charcoal structural steel, subdued blue-green observation glass, naturally aged bronze rings and dish rims, restrained cyan only inside the central planar lens and feed sensors. No pure white, mirror chrome, glossy black glass, saturated neon, red, orange or bright gold.
assets.styleScopeRequest: apply the shared World-122 weathered PBR, readable bevel and soft upper-left isometric lighting language to one prestigious modern academic observatory; it must clearly inherit the high-energy laboratory family while reading as an observation array rather than an industrial factory, power plant or office tower
assets.primaryRequest: one connected symmetric 4x4 planar observation array with a three-storey central control hall, two attached two-storey wings, one centered glazed entrance, one roof-integrated observation rotunda, one supported three-ring planar interferometer and exactly two roof-mounted shallow observation dishes
assets.structureRequest: preserve the exact Blender massing and full 4x4 foundation: one three-storey central hall, exactly two equal attached two-storey wings, one centered glass entrance with backed stairs, one cylindrical roof rotunda, one physically supported three-ring interferometer containing one luminous lens, and exactly two equal shallow dishes mounted on the wing roofs; all equipment remains connected and the entrance stays on the authored front axis
assets.detailRequest: refine the selected planar observatory without changing any floor count, wing, entrance, rotunda, interferometer ring, support pier, dish or foundation; improve only broad pale mineral panels, precast joints, charcoal steel, subdued observation glass, aged bronze hardware and restrained internal cyan sensing light
assets.negativeRequest: do not add or remove floors, move the wings, duplicate or remove a dish, turn the central instrument into a portal or occupied tower, or add standalone antenna masts, satellite clusters, smokestacks, pipes, wind turbines, propellers, industrial tanks, detached annexes, vehicles, roads, people, readable text, logos, exterior cast shadows or scenery
